description: Cooperative Q4/Q8 direct-output promotion record. This sub-variant of the NV sm_120 shared-Q8 max17 lease merges the existing four warp partials inside the producer CTA in the same left-to-right fp32 order and removes 43 standalone completion kernels per token (17 Q and 26 K/V). Promoted after identical token streams, a -47.504 us inclusive device bucket / -52.312 us union profile, depth-512 reverse wall passes at reps 9 and 15 (-15.038 and -22.979 us/token), and a depth-128 pass (-61.639 us/token). TINYGRAD_SHARED_Q8_Q4_PARTIAL_OUTPUT=1 restores the prior partial-output ABI.
